digest.component_or_area: LLM framework / structured output / prompt caching
propositions: Direct Anthropic structured cache canary: two live calls over identical 41.3k-char system prefix produce well-formed completion_verdict results with cache_write_tokens=10697 on call 1 and cache_read_tokens=10697 on call 2, both with requests=1 and finish_reason=stop

Bedrock structured cache canary: two live calls over the same prefix produce identical verdict results with cache_write_tokens=10685 on call 1 and cache_read_tokens=10685 on call 2, both with requests=1
Complete-vs-omit branch instrumentation shows COMPLETE taken on all four calls (1 message in, 1 kept, 0 omitted); OMIT branch not exercised because no failed intermediate output response existed

Observed accounting on all four calls matches the documented contract in docs/llm-framework.md section on structured retry layers: exactly one outer run per call, no transport retry model requests, no native-to-prompted downgrade, cache read/write/input relationship consistent with inclusive-input convention (62 uncached tokens on all calls)

Mixed-provider fallback chain collapses prompt_cache_style to none and zeroes cache counts, which is not a bug but is not documented in the accounting section of docs/llm-framework.md, filed as discovery for documentation follow-up
